audit.summary: The 300×250 creative has critical layout and text readability issues. The headline 'Vivez le confort à votre façon' is partially cut off or difficult to read due to overlap with the product image, creating a broken visual hierarchy. The CTA button 'DÉCOUVRIR LA SÉRIE' lacks sufficient visual spacing from the ad frame bottom edge. Typography does not strictly follow the style guide (headline weight/family unclear). The yellow accent bar 'STYLE & COMFORT' is visually disconnected and the product image dominates, leaving the key messaging compressed.

findings.issue: Headline 'Vivez le confort à votre façon' is partially obscured or overlapped by the product image; text is not fully readable and breaks the visual hierarchy.
findings.fix_hint: Adjust product image positioning (reduce height or shift down) and/or reflow headline to a dedicated text zone above the image with clear margin separation. Ensure headline occupies a distinct readable space without image overlap.

findings.issue: Primary CTA button 'DÉCOUVRIR LA SÉRIE' appears flush or too close to the bottom edge of the #ad-300x250 frame, violating the 20px safe-zone margin requirement.
findings.fix_hint: Add padding-bottom: 20px to #ad-300x250 or margin-bottom: 20px to the CTA button container to ensure visible breathing room from the frame edge.

findings.issue: Typography hierarchy is unclear; headline font-weight and font-family do not visibly follow the style guide (Noto IKEA Latin bold for promo titles or Noto Sans 700 for headings). Current rendering suggests a fallback or unspecified font.
findings.fix_hint: Apply font-family: 'Noto Sans', Verdana, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; to the headline. For the tagline, use font-weight: 400 or 500 (Noto Sans). Ensure web-safe fallback stack includes Verdana.

findings.issue: The yellow accent bar 'STYLE & COMFORT' and the yellow circle accent appear decorative and disconnected from the layout flow; they do not reinforce the primary messaging hierarchy.
findings.fix_hint: Ensure the accent bar is positioned as an intentional design element (e.g. above or integrated with headline) rather than floating. Verify it uses #FBD914 from the primary palette and maintains visual balance with the product image.

findings.issue: Product image scale and positioning dominate the frame; the sofa occupies excessive vertical space, compressing the headline and tagline into a cramped footer zone.
findings.fix_hint: Reduce product image max-height to ~120–140px and apply object-fit: cover or similar to maintain aspect ratio while freeing space for headline and subtext. Adjust image container flex or grid layout to create a 40/60 or 45/55 headline-to-image split.

audit.regeneration_prompt:
1. Reduce product image height to max-height: 120px and reposition to bottom half of ad; create dedicated headline zone (top 40% of #ad-300x250) with no image overlap.
2. Apply font-family: 'Noto Sans', Verdana, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px to headline 'Vivez le confort à votre façon'; ensure full readability.
3. Add padding-bottom: 20px to #ad-300x250 and margin-bottom: 12px to .cta-button to guarantee safe-zone clearance from frame bottom edge.
4. Verify accent bar 'STYLE & COMFORT' uses background: #FBD914 and is positioned as intentional layout element (not floating).
5. Adjust subtext font-weight: 400; font-size: 12px and ensure color contrast meets WCAG on all text.
6. Test all three states (initial, animated, settled) render identically and no text is clipped at 300×250 px boundaries.
